items.title: Tag Editor moves to AWS Resource Explorer: bulk-tag resources across Regions
items.summary: Starting today, you can manage resource tags in bulk in the AWS Resource Explorer console, and requests to Tag Editor console will redirect to Resource Explorer automatically. This post shows how each Tag Editor task works in Resource Explorer and where the steps differ. Benefits of tagging resources in Resource Explorer. Finding resources and tagging […]
